# ToolMaster tools

<!-- Generated by `npm run catalog` from each tool's manifest. Do not edit by hand. -->

Run a tool from a terminal: `toolmaster <id> -i <input> -o <output|-> [-O option=value] [--json]`.
AI agents: `toolmaster mcp` serves every tool below over MCP, with the same names and options.
`-o -` prints a text result to stdout. Exit codes: 0 ok, 2 bad input, 3 policy, 4 tool failed, 5 timeout, 6 engine missing, 7 busy.

| Tool | Category | Reads | Writes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Doc to Markdown `doc-to-markdown` | AI Helpers | .pdf .docx .pptx .xlsx .odt .epub .html .htm .rtf .csv .tsv .tex .ipynb .txt | .md |
| LaTeX to DOCX `latex-to-docx` | Documents | .tex .latex .txt | .docx |
| LaTeX to PDF `latex-to-pdf` | Documents | .tex .latex .txt | .pdf |
| PDF Pages `pdf-pages` | PDF | .pdf | .pdf |

## 🤖 Doc to Markdown (`doc-to-markdown`)

Read PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, EPUB, ODT, RTF, HTML, CSV and LaTeX files as clean Markdown that an AI (or a person) can read.

**Use when:** You must read what is inside a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, EPUB, ODT, RTF, HTML or CSV file. Do not write a pdftotext / python-docx / openpyxl script: run this and read the Markdown.

- Reads: file (.pdf .docx .pptx .xlsx .odt .epub .html .htm .rtf .csv .tsv .tex .ipynb .txt), up to 25 MB
- Writes: .md (`text/markdown; charset=utf-8`)
- Needs: pandoc (GPL-2.0-or-later)

| Option | Values | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | auto \| pdf \| docx \| pptx \| xlsx \| odt \| epub \| html \| rtf \| csv \| tsv \| latex \| ipynb \| text | `"auto"` | File type. auto looks at the bytes, not the file name |
| `markers` | true \| false | `true` | Mark PDF page breaks. adds <!-- page N --> lines so you can cite pages |

```sh
toolmaster doc-to-markdown -i input.pdf -o - -O type=pdf
```

## 📝 LaTeX to DOCX (`latex-to-docx`)

Turn LaTeX into an editable Word document. Headings, lists, tables, links and math carry over.

**Use when:** You have LaTeX source and someone needs an editable Word file. Structure carries over; custom layout macros do not.

- Reads: text (.tex .latex .txt)
- Writes: .docx (`application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document`)
- Needs: pandoc (GPL-2.0-or-later)

| Option | Values | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | auto \| latex \| text | `"auto"` | Input type |
| `toc` | true \| false | `false` | Add a table of contents |

```sh
toolmaster latex-to-docx -i input.tex -o - -O mode=latex
```

## 📄 LaTeX to PDF (`latex-to-pdf`)

Typeset LaTeX (or plain text) into a print-ready PDF. Great for resumes.

**Use when:** You have LaTeX source (a resume, paper or letter) and need a PDF. No TeX installation required; do not write your own pdflatex wrapper.

- Reads: text (.tex .latex .txt)
- Writes: .pdf (`application/pdf`)
- Needs: tectonic (MIT)

| Option | Values | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | auto \| latex \| fragment \| text | `"auto"` | Input type |

```sh
toolmaster latex-to-pdf -i input.tex -o output.pdf -O mode=latex
```

## 📑 PDF Pages (`pdf-pages`)

Pick, reorder, reverse, repeat, delete or rotate PDF pages. Splitting is extracting a range.

**Use when:** You need part of a PDF, a different page order, or rotated/removed pages. Do not write your own PyPDF/qpdf script. Run it once per piece to split a file.

- Reads: file (.pdf), up to 25 MB
- Writes: .pdf (`application/pdf`)
- Needs: nothing to install

| Option | Values | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pages` | text | `"all"` | Pages to keep, in order. Examples: 1-3 | 3,1,2 | all,!2 (drop page 2) | r1,1-r2 (last page first) | 5-2 (reversed) | odd | even | 4-end |
| `rotate` | 0 \| 90 \| 180 \| 270 | `"0"` | Rotate the kept pages (degrees clockwise) |

```sh
toolmaster pdf-pages -i input.pdf -o output.pdf -O rotate=90
```
